name: znetwork_delete_all_dispatch_handlers
description: zNetwork::DeleteAllDispatchHandlers unlinks and deletes every dispatch-handler list node while keeping the sentinel alive.
known_limits: Current VC5SP3 byte comparison is not accepted for tier S: 0x48bf40 has 51 unmasked mismatches after 16 relocation bytes and 6 trimmed VC5 NOPs, with BN size 84 and VC5 size 80. Owner-sized byte acceptance remains blocked by sibling zNetwork dispatch-handler list rows.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x48bf40 validates traversal from g_zNetwork_DispatchHandlerListSentinel->next until the sentinel, unlinking each node through prev/next, deleting only the node object, decrementing g_zNetwork_DispatchHandlerListCount for every removed node, and leaving the sentinel/global pointer intact.

The native smoke registers two packet handlers, calls zNetwork::DeleteAllDispatchHandlers, verifies the sentinel remains allocated and self-linked, verifies the count is zero, and separately frees the handler records because the original function only deletes list nodes.
